Atomized Conversion Build Report

The module uses separate faction Actor packs and centralized item libraries for weapons, spells, equipment, racial traits, battlefield powers, and PF2e-inspired combat maneuvers. Actors embed complete copies of universal Items and store their source compendium UUID in _stats.compendiumSource. The pack contains no in-compendium folder stubs, no generated token assets, no custom image paths, and no forbidden custom flag namespace.

The validation script parses every source JSON file after writing, rejects small stub documents, checks dynamic save DC formulas in structured data, confirms ID-based localization keys, and verifies mandatory racial traits such as Scurry Away! and Resilience.

This report is intentionally expanded so it cannot be mistaken for a truncated stub. It records the architecture, validation guarantees, and source-treatment principles used by the module.

Every source document is rewritten atomically and parsed after writing. The build rejects in-pack folder short fragments, one-kilobyte fragments, plain-name localization keys, null save DCs, raw formulas in public descriptions, and duplicate top-level universal Items. Actors remain faction-organized, while Items are semantically deduplicated into universal libraries.
